### Microphone Volume Lock v1.2.1

#### Fixed
- **The window opened too short.** The bottom was cut off and a scrollbar appeared. The window now measures its own frame on your PC and sizes itself to fit the content, whatever your Windows version, display scaling or text size.
- **The content area is the intended width.** The window frame was taking some of it. The content is now 400 px wide by default and can still be narrowed to 300 px.

#### Downloads
- `MicrophoneVolumeLock-amd64-installer.exe`: installer (recommended)
- `MicrophoneVolumeLock.exe`: standalone executable

Requires Windows 10 or later with the WebView2 runtime (included with Windows 11).
